title: Cultivating Workplace Equity: A Journey in Collective Empowerment
description: Join us as we engage in an enriching dialogue about the impact of "Shared Sisterhood" authored by Beth Livingston and Tina Opie. We shared a conversation about this transformative work that sheds light on how women can unite to cultivate equity in the workplace.

title: Finding Happiness with Nataly Kogan
description: GrasshoppHer is proud to share our coffee chat with Nataly Kogan as she empowers individuals to find true joy and fulfillment. Through her expert guidance, she helps people navigate life's challenges, cultivate gratitude, and embrace a positive mindset. With a focus on self-care and self-love, Nataly's transformative approach has touched countless lives. Join her in the pursuit of happiness and embark on a journey of personal growth and contentment. Discover the key to lasting happiness with Nataly Kogan's invaluable wisdom and experience.

title: Coaching and Salary Negotiation with Aaron Thweatt
description: Meet Aaron Thweatt, a leading expert in coaching and salary negotiation, transforming careers worldwide. With a wealth of experience and insights, Aaron empowers individuals to unlock their full potential, conquer career challenges, and secure the salaries they deserve. Aaron provides personalized coaching and strategic negotiation guidance, making him the go-to professional for achieving professional growth and financial success. Watch our coffee chat with Aaron to take charge of your career journey and experience a transformative path to fulfillment and prosperity.

title: Monetizing your social with Jacklyn Dang
description: Jacklyn Dang, content creator and lead of Creative Product at Tik Tok, is an OG in the world of digital marketing. With 11 years of experience in creative strategy, product operations, social media advertising, and direct response marketing, she’s seen and masterminded it all. Please join us for an unforgettable session where Jacklyn will teach us the insider tricks on how to monetize our online presences.

title: Hope and Healing with Julia Belt
description: May is Mental Health Awareness Month. We all know how important mental fitness is to our overall well-being, so GrasshoppHer is giving our members the tools to keep their minds healthy! We'll be launching the GrasshoppHer Media Hub containing 12 articles on wellness and balance and weekly Coffee Chat Lives with thought leaders and role models. Also, Julia Belt, Founder of Broglie Box and Veza, will enlighten our members during our monthly member virtual event on how she has created new ways to deliver support and connection to those struggling with mental health challenges in today’s hectic, fast-paced, and often impersonal world.

title: Fearless Fridays with GrasshoppHer x Dallas Girl Gang
description:
We are partnering with everyones favorite boss brand. You guessed right, Dallas Girl Gang! Dallas Girl Gang is a community of women supporting each other in career, business and life. They offer events to encourage women in the Dallas/Forth Worth area. Grab a coffee or a custom Fearless Cocktail and hear about local speakers and founders of Dallas Girl Gang and GrasshoppHer. They will be talking about their career lives and offering networking tips.
We can't wait to see you all!

title: Understanding Your Credit with Patrina Dixon from It$ My Money
description: In honor of Financial Literacy Month, we've tapped CEO & Founder of It$ My Money Patrina Dixon to tell us everything we need to know about harnessing our full credit potential. Patrina Dixon is a financial expert, with a passion to serve her community by offering the best financial strategies for you at your stage of life. She is also a #1 Bestselling Author of "A Guided Journal to Help You Manage Your Finances", where she educates on finance and money management skills. Join us to learn about Patrina's hot tips for wrapping our heads around our credit and how we can use it to our advantage. So excited to see you there!

title: GrasshoppHer Presents: International Women's Day during SXSW
description:
Please join Cork & Screw, GrasshoppHer, and  Dress For Success in the celebration of International Women’s Day during!  We are hosting a full day of activations, conversations, and pop ups that celebrate the women in our community who make IT happen every day! This event will bring together Austin’s entrepreneurs, investors, influencers, and other trailblazing women for networking, support, inspiration and flat out fun! Let’s celebrate our lives, our struggles and our successes. Together!

title: Navigating Entrepreneurship with Candace Nelson of Sprinkles
description: Candace Nelson is an Indonesian-born pastry chef and judge on the television series Cupcake Wars and Sugar Rush. In 2005, Candace opened Sprinkles Cupcakes, which was the world's first cupcake bakery. She grew Sprinkles to 22 locations with 38 Cupcake ATMs nationwide and then navigated its sale to a private equity group. She is also the Co-Founder of Pizzana, and the author of The Sprinkles Baking Book and Sweet Success to name a few of her endeavors. Please join us as she gives our GrasshoppHer audience some special tips and tricks on navigating entrepreneurship both inside and outside of the workplace.

title: Sculpt & Tone w/ Lindsay Howe at Free People Movement
description: J﻿oin GrasshoppHer for a special, revitalizing treat on February 21st at 6:30p CT.  Free People Movement has invited us to get our bods moving and shake off the February chill at their new studio in Austin. The first 10 people to sign up will be free! Use this link: https://app.arketa.co/fpmovementaustin/checkout/zWxquOjuBXzI7mwZW2OS and promo code GRASSHOPPHER at checkout.

title: Practicing Mental Fitness In The Workplace with Mandy Teefey
description: Mandy Teefey is a co-founder and co-CEO of Wondermind, as well as the founder and CEO of Kicked to the Curb Productions, where she has developed award winning and nominated content. She is also Selena Gomez's mom, which is why she, Selena and co-founder Daniella Pierson are on a mission to help you show up for your mental health... in an accessible way. Please join us to learn about how Mandy and team are democratizing mental health and how you can practice mental fitness in the workplace.

title: Adopting a Growth Mindset with Danielle Langton
description:
Join us for our first in-person event of 2023! We'll be featuring Danielle Langton, who is a strategic business consultant and coach located in Austin, TX. Danielle serves 
entrepreneurs by helping them build sustainable businesses and long-lasting legacies.  Join us for a fireside chat to hear Danielle's thoughts on how you can adopt a growth mindset in your field and set yourself off on the best foot in 2023.

title: Adopt a Growth Mindset
description: As the CEO of Hello Sunshine, Sarah Harden changes the narrative for women. Sarah works with Reese Witherspoon, founder of Hello Sunshine, to "put women at the center of every story [they] create, celebrate, and discover," with 18 productions nominated for Emmys. Join us to hear how Sarah developed a growth mindset to help her navigate her career. If this is something that piques your interest, be sure to come prepared with questions for the Q&A portion of the event. Looking forward to seeing you there!

title: Reset & Pivot
description: Join us on December 14th to Reset & Pivot before the holidays! We are looking forward to seeing you there.

title: Navigating Rejection
description: Known for her roles as Lily van der Woodsen on Gossip Girl and Megan Lewis on Melrose Place, Kelly Rutherford is a successful actress with a passion for empowering women and children. This passion has led her to support organizations such as StepUp Women's Network and Free Arts NYC. Join us at our virtual event to learn how Kelly navigates rejection. Looking forward to seeing you all there!

title: INVESTING IN YOURSELF
description: We're getting deep.  In partnership with the Young Women's Alliance, we'll discuss how community can benefit you! Looking forward to seeing you there!

title: INVESTING IN YOURSELF WITH STYLIST AND DESIGNER JOEY TIERNEY
description: Touted by WWD Beauty Biz's “It List,” Los Angeles based stylist and designer Joey Tierney has garnered international attention from the fashion, music and entertainment industries. She is is also credited with styling some of Hollywood’s leading talent such as Oscar Winner Billy Bob Thornton, Britney Spears, Andy Garcia, Rose Byrne, Viggo Mortenson, Kristen Bell, Juliette Lewis, and Betty White to name a few. She has launched fashion labels “Joey Tierney” and “Joey and T” and is  the co-founder of Rue Ltd., a streetwear company partnered with the Orangewood Foundation with a mission to give back by offering guidance and resources to foster and community youth. We are excited to hear about Joey's journey and her tips for investing in ourselves.  Looking forward to seeing you all there!

title: PowerToFly's Diversity Reboot: Early Career Connections & Mid Career Pivots with GrasshoppHer
description: Hear GrasshoppHer and PowerToFly's discussion on mentorship and how it impacts your early and mid-career moves.

description: In this conversation, we tackle emotional, mental and physical well-being as well as the importance of self-care with Founder of CCM Fitness Cara D'Orazio and award-winning real estate agent and author Venus Morris Griffin.
